features.title: Login (classic flow)
features.summary: Email/password against AuthenticationApi/login; stores authToken and user ids.
features.content:
## login.component.ts

Posts to `{baseUrl}/AuthenticationApi/login`. On success, persists `authToken`, `userId`, `licenseId`, `userRoleName`, `roleId` in **localStorage** for subsequent guards and API calls.

features.title: Login v2 / registration
features.summary: login-v2 uses AuthenticationApi/Register for sign-up style entry with timezone.
features.content:
## login-v2.component.ts

Sends `Register` payload including `LocalTimeZone`. Still relies on the same localStorage keys for session continuity and pending QR save after signup.

features.title: Forgot password & OTP
features.summary: Forgot-password flow with OTP verification endpoints.
features.content:
## forgot-password.component.ts

Coordinates with `AuthenticationApi` endpoints for requesting reset and verifying OTP (`VerifyForgotPasswordOtp`). Always validate rate limiting and OTP expiry on the server (see PenTest docs).

features.title: Set / reset password
features.content:
## set-password.component.ts

Uses token/user context from the reset link or prior step, then posts new password to `ResetPassword`.

features.title: AuthGuard
features.summary: Blocks routes when authToken (or equivalent) is missing.
features.content:
## auth.guard.ts

Standard pattern: read `localStorage` for `authToken` and `userId`; redirect to login if absent. Keep guard logic in sync with any interceptor that attaches Authorization headers.

features.title: AdminGuard
features.summary: Restricts admin modules to elevated roles.
features.content:
## admin.guard.ts

Checks role name or role id from storage (e.g. `userRoleName`, `roleId`) before activating admin routes such as loyalty dashboards or QR admin screens.

features.title: Google OAuth hook
features.summary: login.component exposes googleLogin path when configured.
features.content:
## Google

`AuthenticationApi/googleLogin` integrates with Google token from the client. Ensure `googleClientId` in `environment` matches your OAuth console project.

features.title: Session storage keys
features.summary: Common localStorage keys used across the app.
features.content:
## Keys

Typical keys: `authToken`, `userId`, `licenseId`, `userRoleName`, `roleId`. Any new feature that calls SmartQRApi should read `userId` from the same source of truth.
